data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘thorn’ and ‘dic’ meaning ‘worker’ or ‘doer’, Thorndike is a name that represents strength and resilience. The name Thorndike is often associated with the strong and sturdy character of oak trees and thorny roses. The name Thorndike carries the meaning “Thorn-worker” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Thorndike usually hope their child will grow to embody thorn-worker and live with faith, good character and purpose.
